steps.note: Enable eRFX projects for the test company.
Allow vendors to be added during event creation.
Verify the PR quantity of 10 units was carried into the event.
Provide the mandatory event title.
Commit the 30-minute bidding schedule.
Invite two vendors for Vendor A and Vendor B bidding.
Publish the auction event.
Verify the event reached its published project page.
Submit Vendor A's initial bid of 100.
Verify the initial bid was accepted.
Submit Vendor A's revised bid of 85.
Verify the revised bid was accepted.
Submit Vendor B's bid of 88.
Verify Vendor B's bid was accepted.
Wait for the auction to close before awarding.
Open the buyer's comparison grid after bidding closes.
Verify ranking follows the lowest auction amount.
Verify Vendor A's revised 85 bid is ranked first.
Verify Vendor A's awarded amount calculation is rate multiplied by quantity.
Award all line items to the lowest bidder, Vendor A at 85.
Verify the award proposal was created and submitted.

args.remark: Approved for the lowest compliant auction bid.

steps.note: Approve the submitted award with the required remark.
Complete the approved award and create the purchase order.
Verify the PO contains the single awarded PR line with quantity 10.
Return to the events list to verify final placement.
Open the History tab after completion.
Verify this plan's completed event moved to History.
